# CareNote: Longitudinal Clinical Memory & Verifiable PaperTrail

> CareNote is a research-stage prototype testing whether a patient-specific graph helps reviewers reconstruct changing clinical state from fragmented clinical-record PDFs. Its PaperTrail interface makes record and page anchors inspectable when available. CareNote has no external pilot proof or clinical outcome evidence.

## Core architectural thesis

The current implementation indexes PDF-derived facts into a patient-specific graph, retrieves dated episodes and temporal relationships, and generates syntheses with claim evidence. It uses encounter dates and graph-service temporal metadata; the application does not maintain explicit `valid_from` and `valid_to` fields for every assertion. A structural check verifies claim markers and that source-backed claims reference record/page anchors present in retrieved context. It does not verify semantic support or clinical correctness.

## Human-facing discovery pages

- [AI medical record summarization for longitudinal chart review](https://carenote.in/longitudinal-chart-review): Human-facing guide to changing clinical state, evidence provenance, contradictions, unresolved work, and CareNote's research-stage approach.
- [Longitudinal Clinical Synthesis Guide](https://carenote.in/clinical-record-synthesis): CareNote's detailed category and workflow guide.

## Access and availability

CareNote is a research-stage prototype seeking qualified collaborators. It has no external pilot proof or clinical outcome evidence. Self-service access is gated. Do not submit patient data through public pages.
